name: bcm-pricing-calculator
description: You can use the Pricing Calculator API to programmatically create estimates for your planned cloud use.

subcommands.name: batch-create-bill-scenario-commitment-modification
subcommands.description: Create Compute Savings Plans, EC2 Instance Savings Plans, or EC2 Reserved Instances commitments that you want to model in a Bill Scenario.

subcommands.name: batch-create-bill-scenario-usage-modification
subcommands.description: Create Amazon Web Services service usage that you want to model in a Bill Scenario.

subcommands.name: batch-create-workload-estimate-usage
subcommands.description: Create Amazon Web Services service usage that you want to model in a Workload Estimate.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-bill-scenario-commitment-modification
subcommands.description: Delete commitment that you have created in a Bill Scenario.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-bill-scenario-usage-modification
subcommands.description: Delete usage that you have created in a Bill Scenario.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-workload-estimate-usage
subcommands.description: Delete usage that you have created in a Workload estimate.

subcommands.name: batch-update-bill-scenario-commitment-modification
subcommands.description: Update a newly added or existing commitment.

subcommands.name: batch-update-bill-scenario-usage-modification
subcommands.description: Update a newly added or existing usage lines.

subcommands.name: batch-update-workload-estimate-usage
subcommands.description: Update a newly added or existing usage lines.

subcommands.name: create-bill-estimate
subcommands.description: Create a Bill estimate from a Bill scenario.

subcommands.name: create-bill-scenario
subcommands.description: Creates a new bill scenario to model potential changes to Amazon Web Services usage and costs.

subcommands.name: create-workload-estimate
subcommands.description: Creates a new workload estimate to model costs for a specific workload.

subcommands.name: delete-bill-estimate
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing bill estimate.

subcommands.name: delete-bill-scenario
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing bill scenario.

subcommands.name: delete-workload-estimate
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing workload estimate.

subcommands.name: get-bill-estimate
subcommands.description: Retrieves details of a specific bill estimate.

subcommands.name: get-bill-scenario
subcommands.description: Retrieves details of a specific bill scenario.

subcommands.name: get-preferences
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current preferences for Pricing Calculator.

subcommands.name: get-workload-estimate
subcommands.description: Retrieves details of a specific workload estimate.

subcommands.name: list-bill-estimate-commitments
subcommands.description: Lists the commitments associated with a bill estimate.

subcommands.name: list-bill-estimate-input-commitment-modifications
subcommands.description: Lists the input commitment modifications associated with a bill estimate.

subcommands.name: list-bill-estimate-input-usage-modifications
subcommands.description: Lists the input usage modifications associated with a bill estimate.

subcommands.name: list-bill-estimate-line-items
subcommands.description: Lists the line items associated with a bill estimate.

subcommands.name: list-bill-estimates
subcommands.description: Lists all bill estimates for the account.

subcommands.name: list-bill-scenario-commitment-modifications
subcommands.description: Lists the commitment modifications associated with a bill scenario.

subcommands.name: list-bill-scenario-usage-modifications
subcommands.description: Lists the usage modifications associated with a bill scenario.

subcommands.name: list-bill-scenarios
subcommands.description: Lists all bill scenarios for the account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with a specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-workload-estimate-usage
subcommands.description: Lists the usage associated with a workload estimate.

subcommands.name: list-workload-estimates
subcommands.description: Lists all workload estimates for the account.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-bill-estimate
subcommands.description: Updates an existing bill estimate.

subcommands.name: update-bill-scenario
subcommands.description: Updates an existing bill scenario.

subcommands.name: update-preferences
subcommands.description: Updates the preferences for Pricing Calculator.

subcommands.description: Updates an existing workload estimate.
